summary: Add FOODPANDA_TOKEN so the customer-scoped commands work without a desktop Chrome profile.
reason: config.go documented an env-var session path in AuthHeader() and CookieCredential() that no os.Getenv ever implemented, so 'home' and 'addresses' were unreachable from CI, containers and agent sandboxes.
validated_outcome: go test ./... (13/13 packages); flag surfaces in --help; live dogfood full 108/108.
